value.subtitle: An identity for audio fiction — « aujourd’hui, les séries s’écoutent ».

hero.alt: Plé brand image — a phone outline drawn over a listener
hero.caption: The phone drawn as a frame: the story happens through it, not on it.

sections.heading: A name you can say out loud
sections.body: The premise fits in a sentence: series are something you listen to now. The mark takes it literally — a play triangle cut into a yellow tile, sitting next to a short, spoken name — because the identity is judged at its smallest size first.

facts.title: App icon
facts.body: A few millimetres, on a home screen full of competitors.

facts.title: Cover thumbnail
facts.body: In a grid, next to artwork that is louder than it.

facts.title: Glanced at while walking
facts.body: Read in motion, at arm’s length, once.

images.alt: Plé logotype, tagline and play mark on black
images.caption: Mark, name and line — the whole brand in one slide.

sections.heading: What it looks like as a product
sections.body: A brand for audio fiction has to survive a library, a player and an episode page before it means anything. These concept screens put the mark under that pressure: covers side by side, a player that stays legible in one hand, and an episode list where the typography does the sorting.

images.alt: Plé app concept screens: library, player and series page
